address.description: The destination as the sandbox asked for it

intercepted.description: Studio handled the HTTP requests (proxy rules and hosts with secrets)

source.description: Where the host name came from

hosts.description: Host patterns the value may be sent to, e.g. api.openai.com or *.example.com

name.description: Environment variable name sandboxes see, e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY

value.description: The secret value. It is sealed on arrival and never returned.

action.description: allow or deny creates a rule; dismiss only closes the request

host.description: Host pattern the rule covers; empty means the requested host

ports.description: Ports the rule covers; omitted means the default ports for the request, empty means any port

scope.description: Whether the rule covers only the requesting sandbox

location.description: Where the error occurred, e.g. 'body.items[3].tags' or 'path.thing-id'

value.description: The value at the given location

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
examples: Property foo is required but is missing.

errors.description: Optional list of individual error details

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. This value should not change between occurrences of the error.

type.description: A URI reference to human-readable documentation for the error.

patterns.description: Suggested host patterns, most specific first

host.description: example.com, *.example.com (includes example.com), or an IP address

caddyfile.description: caddy rules only: the routes of a Caddy site, in Caddyfile syntax, that handle the requests. reverse_proxy may send secrets upstream in header_up as {secret.NAME}, over HTTPS to hosts the secret is bound to.

headers.description: proxy rules only: headers set on every request, replacing the sandbox's. Values may reference secrets as {secret.NAME}, which are only sent over HTTPS to hosts the secret is bound to.

action.description: allow passes connections through untouched; proxy lets Studio handle the HTTP requests, to set headers; caddy hands them to a Caddyfile

host.description: example.com, *.example.com (includes example.com), or an IP address

ports.description: Empty or omitted means any port

sandboxId.description: Limits the rule to one sandbox of this environment

hosts.description: Host patterns the value may be sent to

value.description: A new value. Omit it to keep the stored one.

get.description: Approvals of every environment, newest first. Pending ones feed the approval inbox.
